events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first broadcast.

angles.name: MTV Launch
angles.copy: Remember when music videos changed everything? Forty-five years ago today, MTV hit the airwaves, kicking off with The Buggles. Did video really kill the radio star? We're still here!

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring anthems like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever'.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years of 'Definitely Maybe'! Oasis's debut album dropped today in '94, launching them into legend. What's your favourite track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, an 'Aquarian Exposition: 3 Days of Peace & Music', took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the Woodstock festival began, bringing '3 Days of Peace & Music' to half a million people. A truly iconic moment in music history.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago today, we lost the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to inspire generations. Always remembered.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur, a hugely influential hip-hop artist, died on September 13, 1996, from injuries sustained in a shooting a week prior, at the age of 25. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty years ago this week, we lost a true rap icon. Remembering Tupac Shakur, whose music and message continue to resonate. He would have been 55.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, widely regarded as one of the greatest guitarists of all time, passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago today, the world lost a guitar legend. Remembering Jimi Hendrix, whose innovative sound continues to shape music. He would have been 84.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover and timeless tracks still sound as fresh today.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, turning 75 today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders icon, still rocking and inspiring.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis and a solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972, celebrating his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The definitive voice of a generation, still bringing the rock 'n' roll. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal solo album 'Imagine' in the UK on October 8, 1971, featuring the iconic title track.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago today, John Lennon gave us the 'Imagine' album. A timeless message of peace and hope that resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod, changing how we listen to music forever. Who remembers their first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day, celebrated on October 5th, marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit cinemas, introducing the world to 007. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940. He would have been 86 today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. A true visionary whose music and message still resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, a founding member of Monty Python, was born on October 27, 1939, turning 87 today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. An incredibly diverse and groundbreaking double LP. What's your favourite track?
